description.value: A prospective study evaluating grey matter volume in young adults with a long history of heavy alcohol use that did not meet criteria for alcohol use disorder, compared with matched light-drinking controls.

spans.text: The present prospective study evaluated GM volume in a group of young adults by conducting MR imaging after a 10-year history of heavy alcohol use and compared it to age- and gender-matched light-drinking controls.

description.value: Prospective observational longitudinal cohort study with alcohol use assessed at three time-points and structural MRI acquired at the final time-point.
